entries.title: Plates, AI & Gameplay Update
changes: This update brings new ways to play with plates and UX Mega-evolution figures. Pokemon trainers will be able to show their skills by evolving their pokemon.
🟨 PLATES
Added the Plate system to battles, including visual Plate cards, Plate activation animations and sound effects.
Random Teams now receive a legal random Plate deck and automatically include a compatible Mega Plate when possible.
⚔️ BATTLES & ABILITIES
Multiple buffs on the same Pokémon now appear one at a time, with individual sounds.
Buffs and debuffs affecting both battle opponents now activate simultaneously, with the battle result waiting until all effects finish.
Fixed dual-type bonuses such as Fight Song, allowing Dragon/Flying Pokémon like Rayquaza to receive both bonuses.
Implemented Mega Rayquaza's Ripped Sky Reign movement and battle effects.
Fixed Imprison visually failing to turn affected wheel segments into Misses.
Optional Abilities such as Melemele Wish now ask the player whether to activate them and allow the player to choose the target.
Fixed pass-through Abilities incorrectly allowing Pokémon to enter through blocked Entry Points.
Fixed Shiny and regular Tapu Koko not sharing the correct pass-through behavior.
Fixed Tidal Wave push distance and Wait behavior.
Fixed Psycho Cut respins not correctly preserving the Psycho Cut result.
Fixed Psyshock interactions with existing status conditions and Wait.
Fixed an incorrect Lucario ability assignment that could cause Gold-vs-Purple interactions.
Added the proper Noxious status marker.
Mouse over a Pokémon instead of clicking it to see its information during a battle.
👥 TEAMS & MULTIPLAYER
Shiny and regular versions of the same Pokémon now count as the same species toward the team copy limit.
Random Teams now automatically attach available evolutions and Mega Evolutions when possible.
Added Team Editor access during the online lobby/team-selection flow.
Improved saved-team selection for multiplayer matches.
Replaced the redundant Settings button at the bottom of the Teams menu with a Back button.
Removed unnecessary Ability hover overlays now that Ability information is scrollable.
🎨 UI, AUDIO & FEEDBACK
Added the Duel Log, providing a scrollable history of important actions during a match. Players can use this when bug reporting.
Added a permanent turn indicator and improved turn-change banner timing.
End Turn is now correctly disabled when it is not your turn in AI and online matches.
Added winner and loser jingles at the end of duels.
Added Plate activation and evolution/devolution sound effects.
Pokémon that are excluded from the duel now fly upward and disappear from the board.
Surround knockouts now play the normal knockout/hit sound.
Added remaining Mega Evolution turns to the Pokémon information card.
Fixed some internal control/debug text appearing in player-facing descriptions.
Improved several wheel, tooltip and battle-feedback visuals.
🐛 ADDITIONAL FIXES
Fixed several multiplayer, movement, targeting and battle-resolution cases.
